    AI Overview
    The Artemis 2 Orion capsule is a compact, cone-shaped spacecraft measuring 16.5 feet (5 meters) in diameter and roughly 11 feet tall, with 330 cubic feet (about 9.3 cubic meters) of habitable volume. Designed for four astronauts, the interior is often compared to the size of two minivans, offering 60% more room than Apollo command modules. 
    This video shows the interior of the Orion capsule and how astronauts will live and work inside:
    40s
    BBC News
    YouTube• Mar 31, 2026
    Key size and space details for the Orion capsule include: 
    • Dimensions: ~16.5 ft wide (heat shield diameter) and ~11 ft tall.
    • Habitable Volume: 330 cubic feet (
      ∼9.3tilde 9.3
       cubic meters).
    • Crew Capacity: 4 astronauts.
    • Comparison: Roughly 60% larger than Apollo capsules, yet described as compact and efficient for the 10-day, four-person mission.
    • Features: Includes a toilet, exercise equipment, and a medical kit within the cabin.
